text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Deploy paused for release v2.18.0 (candidate 2024-11-02) — Canary failed in eu-west-1 (503 on /infer). Auto-hold engaged.

Sara K: seeing ingress 503 spikes starting ~09:12 UTC. A few 5xx from the new proxy sidecar during canary traffic.

Kevin M: logs show `upstream_reset` and `503` from envoy -> backend tcp RST. Could be LB healthcheck flapping.

Alex P: canaries hit ~10% traffic. We should rollback the canary or pin to previous image. Suggest pin to v2.17.9 for eu-west-1 and let remaining regions proceed.

Maria L: agree with pin but we need to record release-note impact. Will add an incident note and mark release as "deferred for eu-west-1".

TJ: ops-oncall, what's ETA on investigating the ingress controller? If it's >30m we should reschedule the EU change window.

ops-oncall: I'm on it, pulling kube-proxy/envoy metrics. Initial hypothesis: node-level conntrack exhaustion on a subset of hosts; ramped traffic during canary pushed them. Recreating a node showed conntrack reset cleared traffic. ETA 20m.

Lili: if conntrack is the culprit, can we reduce canary QPS to 2rps per instance and retry? Or scale extra nodes for safety?

Alex P: don't experiment mid-rollout. Plan: 1) rollback canary to v2.17.9 for eu-west-1, 2) unpause other regions only after ops signoff, 3) schedule a follow-up canary once root cause fixed.

deploy-bot: Action logged: `rollback canary eu-west-1 -> v2.17.9` initiated by Alex P. Deploy job #dpl-6421 queued.

ops-oncall: confirmed node drains on 3 hosts correlated with conntrack full. I've applied a temporary sysctl bump and restarted envoy on affected nodes. Monitoring for 5m.

Kevin M: after restart, 200s returned for the canary traffic. No 503s in last 3m.

Sara K: thanks — will keep an eye on request latencies. Maria, please update the release notes and the rollout doc to reflect the regional pin.

Maria L: updated release notes: "EU canary rolled back due to ingress instability; global rollout paused for verification. See incident-2024-11-02 for RCA." Also created follow-up ticket: INF-4892 (postmortem + remediation).

TJ: re: reschedule — propose new EU change window at 2024-11-02 18:00 UTC if ops gives greenlight by 17:30 UTC. If not, we'll push to next day. Lili ok to coordinate with SRE on scaled canary?

Lili: I can coordinate. I'll run a scaled dry-run in staging and validate conntrack tuning before re-run.

Alex P: thumbs up. After ops final confirms, we can plan a targeted canary with smaller ramp and healthcheck tweaks.

deploy-bot: Note: manual approvals required to unpause. React with :thumbsup: to acknowledge.

Sara K: :thumbsup:

Kevin M: :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: monitoring looks stable. I'll post an all-clear when we've held for 30m without recurrence.

Maria L: filing the customer-facing blurb draft in #product for review.

TJ: thanks all — tagging this thread for release coordinator sync.

deploy-bot: thread closed for now; reopen with `/deploy resume` once approvals and ops confirmation are present.
